title: GMI technology economic-change evidence envelope v1 (technology_economic_change.evidence.v1)
description: Closed evidence envelope for the Technology ex-Semis company-first research profile (T8A, macro#7891; proposed §8 shape @ 382c0b399d5c on #7870, under Sol adjudication). Exactly ONE authorized, already-accepted shared curation assertion, deep-copied VERBATIM from the owner bundle. The assertion's internal shape — its authority block included — is validated by that assertion's owner, theme_graph.curation_assertion.v1 (macro#7870), not by this schema: the owner's authority_not_all_false code rule runs on every render, before anything can be cited, and refuses any assertion whose authority flags are not all literally false. That owner-side rule is why no mirror of the assertion's internals lives here, and why a mirror would be strictly worse than none — v1.1 of the owner contract is in flight, so a mirror written here would be a fork with a stale-by-design clock. This schema deliberately asserts NOTHING about the assertion's internal shape; the assertion is deliberately the only open object here. The generation is the dossier_id of the composed dossier that actually rendered the citing row/card/counter, so the envelope can never cite a projection it was not selected from. Unknown and not-selected references share one refusal code, so the envelope discloses no existence. Authority ceiling research_display_only: the envelope's own six flags literally false (ECD-48); this envelope ranks, gates, sizes, vetoes, originates and opens nothing.
